text.Katılım Bankalarında Finansman Nasıl İşl: How Does Financing Work at Participation Banks? - KredimGeldi
text.Katılım bankaları faiz yerine kâr payı i: Participation banks work with profit share instead of interest. We explain murabaha, home and vehicle financing, and how they differ from conventional loans, in plain language.
text.Temel ilke: Faiz yerine kâr payı: The core principle: Profit share instead of interest
text.Almak istediğiniz ürünü (ev, araç, eşya): You choose the product you want to buy (a home, a car, goods) and the seller.
text.Katılım bankası ürünü satıcıdan satın al: The participation bank buys the product from the seller.
text.Banka ürünü, maliyet ve kâr payı açıkça: The bank sells the product to you on deferred terms, clearly stating the cost and the profit share.
text.Siz de toplam tutarı belirlenen taksitle: You then pay the total amount in set installments.
text.Ödeme planı sözleşmede baştan belirlendi: Because the payment plan is fixed in the contract from the start, your installments stay the same throughout the term, just as with conventional fixed-rate loans.
text.Hangi finansman türleri var?: What types of financing are there?
text.Klasik krediyle farkları: How it differs from a conventional loan
text.Nakit olarak hesaba yatırılır: Deposited into your account as cash
text.Genellikle doğrudan satıcıya ödenir: Usually paid directly to the seller
text.Kullanım amacı serbesttir: Can be used for any purpose
text.Belirli bir mal veya hizmet alımıdır: Purchase of a specific good or service
text.Katılım bankaları da BDDK tarafından den: Participation banks are also supervised by BDDK (the Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency). Savings in participation accounts are covered by the Savings Deposit Insurance Fund (TMSF), just like deposits at conventional banks.
text.Farklı bankaların tekliflerini aynı tuta: Compare different banks' offers based on the same amount and term.
text.Katılım bankasında finansman almak için: What do I need to get financing from a participation bank?
text.Klasik bankalardakine benzer şekilde kim: Similar to conventional banks, your ID, proof of income and credit score are assessed. You'll also be asked for the invoice or sale details of the product to be financed.
text.Katılım bankasından nakit alabilir miyim: Can I get cash from a participation bank?
text.Genellikle hayır. Finansman belirli bir: Usually not. Financing is provided for the purchase of a specific good or service, and payment is mostly made directly to the seller.
text.Katılım bankaları devlet güvencesinde mi: Are participation banks backed by the state?
text.Katılım bankaları BDDK tarafından denetl: Participation banks are supervised by BDDK, and participation accounts are covered by TMSF.

html.Türkiye'de bankacılık sistemi mevduat ba: In Türkiye, the banking system is divided into two: deposit banks and participation banks. Participation banks operate according to interest-free finance principles and offer their customers financing instead of a "loan." So what does this difference mean in practice?
html.Katılım bankaları para karşılığında para: Participation banks don't lend money in exchange for money; instead, they act as an intermediary in the purchase of a good or service. The bank buys the product from the seller and sells it to you on deferred terms, adding a set profit share. On the deposit side, instead of fixed interest, there are participation accounts based on sharing in the profit the bank earns.
html.Bireysel finansmanda en yaygın yöntem <s: The most common method in personal financing is murabaha. Here's how it works:
html.<strong>Konut finansmanı:</strong> Ev al: Home financing: When you buy a home, the bank purchases the property and sells it to you on deferred terms. Some participation banks also offer different structures such as lease certificates (sukuk) or ijara.
html.<strong>Taşıt finansmanı:</strong> Sıfır: Vehicle financing: Used for buying a new or used vehicle.
html.<strong>Bireysel ihtiyaç finansmanı:</st: Personal needs financing: Unlike a conventional personal loan, no cash is paid out directly; a specific purchase such as goods, education or renovation is financed.
html.Katılım bankaları ve mevduat bankalarını: When comparing offers from participation banks and deposit banks, don't look at the profit share or interest rate; look at the total repayment amount and the annual cost rate shown in the pre-contract information form. Fees, insurance terms and early repayment rules also affect the total cost.
